## Wave 1 Summary

Wave 1 carries the EVOI Tier-1 a(t)/C10 keystone-successor gates plus the two EVOI Tier-2 register-sourced observational gates. Two items are S99 successors that map a corridor rather than reopen it on a whim: **S100a-SF54-MAPPING** (W1-1 INFO successor — re-derive whether SF54 `[−0.97, +0.81]` is the correct comparison object for the bare-frame `q_bare` history, or whether the `a_eff→SF54` Connes-distance proxy needs a frame/normalization correction) and **S100a-QEQ-DRIVE** (W2-1 FAIL successor — derive a substrate-internal `q_eq(H)` drive from the Volovik Gibbs-Duhem back-reaction and test whether the `d ln q/d ln H = 1` tracking leg emerges UNFORCED, i.e. without the imposed `q ∝ H` simple-fluid closure). Two items are register-sourced (no prior WP CF existed): **S100a-NS-NLO** (EVOI Tier-2 rank 6 — second-order slow-variation correction to the PROVEN leading-order `n_s = 0.9561`, gating precision-stability of the headline tilt) and **S100a-SIGMA-DM-NUCLEON** (EVOI Tier-2 rank 7 / atlas #10 — turn the Leggett-channel GGE-quasiparticle DM identity into a direct-detection prediction by computing `σ_DM-nucleon` and pre-registering it against the LZ/XENONnT exclusion curves and the neutrino fog).

Wave 1 is structurally independent of all other waves (per `session-100a-partition.md` dependency graph). All four gates post-process existing substrate data (S99 npz caches, the L_max=12 spectrum cache, canonical spectral moments) or derive closed-form substrate quantities; none requires a fresh `D_K` diagonalization.

## Wave 1 Decision Point Prerequisites

No upstream-verdict prerequisite is unmet at dispatch time. All four gates consume FROZEN on-disk inputs:

- **S100a-SF54-MAPPING** consumes `computations/session-99/s99_w1_q_nonratio_observable.npz` (S99-W1-Q-NONRATIO-OBSERVABLE verdict = INFO, landed; on disk, 146497 bytes) + `sessions/framework/equation-collab/little-red-dots-synthesis.md` (SF54 derivation, curated, on disk) + `canonical_constants.py` (`Omega_BA_fold = 2.241353`, `a_2_FW_zeta = 2776.165389`).
- **S100a-QEQ-DRIVE** consumes `computations/session-99/s99_w2_relaxation_closure.npz` (S99-W2-RELAXATION-CLOSURE verdict = FAIL, landed; on disk, 72276 bytes) + `s99_w1_q_nonratio_observable.npz` (`arr_H_bare_t`) + `canonical_constants.py` (`a_0_FW_zeta = 6440.0`).
- **S100a-NS-NLO** consumes `canonical_constants.py` (`n_s_framework = 0.9561`, `a_2_FW_zeta`, `a_4_FW_zeta = 1350.7216`) + B1 trajectory (the constant-ε spectral-geometry slow-roll machinery underlying `n_s = 1 − 2ε_H`).
- **S100a-SIGMA-DM-NUCLEON** consumes `canonical_constants.py` (`Mass_LeggettDM_over_Delta_BCS = 11.97`, `Delta_BCS = 0.4642547394830737`, `M_KK = 7.428660036284456e16`, `sigma_over_m = 5.7e-51`) + LZ/XENONnT 2024 exclusion-curve digitization.

Since every prereq verdict is already landed (one PASS-class anchor, two INFO/FAIL corridor-maps, all on disk), NO gate in this wave is at risk of mechanical closure per `.claude/rules/mechanical-closure-discipline.md`. Each gate runs to a genuine substrate-physics verdict.

```yaml
# ---- Identity (6 fields) ----
gate_id: "S100a-W1-1-SF54-MAPPING"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[SIGN]"
classification: "PHONONIC"
agent_type: "transit-dynamics-theorist"
hypothesis: "The SF54 deceleration band [−0.97, +0.81] is the correct comparison object for the bare-frame q_bare(τ) history ONLY after the a_eff(a₂-channel)→SF54 Connes-distance proxy is frame/normalization-corrected; under the corrected map the substrate is structurally mostly-accelerating post-fold (q_bare < 0 median), so the S99 W1-1 band-miss (band_frac 0.490) is a genuine substrate prediction (SF54 is the wrong band), not an ill-defined mapping."

method:
  description: "Re-derive the a_eff(a₂-channel)→SF54 deceleration-band map from the little-red-dots SF54 derivation; recompute the Connes-distance proxy with the frame/normalization correction (bare-frame vs SF54-frame a_eff); load arr_q_bare_t / arr_H_bare_t / arr_tau from the S99 W1-1 npz; recompute in-band fraction under the corrected map; classify per the three-branch rubric. 1D post-processing — NO diagonalization."
  producing_script: "computations/_shared/s100a_w1_sf54_mapping.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "set"
  form: "band_frac_corrected = (1/N) · Σ_τ 𝟙[ q_corrected(τ) ∈ [−0.97, +0.81] ];  q_corrected(τ) = map_correct(q_bare(τ); Ω_BA_fold, a₂-channel frame factor)"

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "0.90"
  direction: ">="

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: false
  proof_ref: "N/A — band_frac is an empirical count over the discretized τ-grid; the 0.90 PASS boundary is a pre-registered coverage threshold (matches the W1-1 INFO pre-registration), not an analytically-derived value"

# (4) reachable_rationals
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: true
  mesh_density: "N_τ grid points from s99_w1_q_nonratio_observable.npz arr_tau (band_frac ∈ {0, 1/N, …, 1} rational mesh)"

# (5) machinery_pin_map
machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "len(arr_tau) from s99_w1_q_nonratio_observable.npz (runtime-read, the W1-1 τ-grid)"
  L_max: "N/A — 1D post-processing of cached q_bare(τ); no spectral truncation"
  scan_range: "[arr_tau.min(), arr_tau.max()] — the W1-1 transit window (fold-centred)"
  step_size: "inherited from arr_tau grid (non-uniform; as cached)"
  tolerance: "band edges exact at [−0.97, +0.81]; band-membership is a closed inequality (no tol slack)"
  scheme: "FW"
  convention: "CONNES-DISTANCE-PROXY-FRAME-CORRECTED"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "numpy.linalg (cpu-cap-OMP8) — 1D array op, matrix-free; set OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 before import numpy"
  publication_precision: "4 sig figs (band_frac_corrected; matches the W1-1 band_frac_primary=0.490 / q_bare median −0.866 precision)"

# (6) audit_discriminators
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "Under the frame-corrected a_eff→SF54 map, the substrate is structurally mostly-accelerating post-fold (q_corrected median < 0), so band_frac < 0.90 is a genuine substrate prediction, NOT a mapping defect."

    Definition 1: q_bare(τ) = −ä·a / ȧ²  evaluated on the bare-frame backbone a(τ),
                  from s99_w1_q_nonratio_observable.npz (arr_q_bare_t); the W1-1
                  non-ratio deceleration observable. [S99-W1-Q-NONRATIO-OBSERVABLE, INFO]
    Definition 2: SF54 band = [q_min, q_max] = [−0.97, +0.81]  (little-red-dots-synthesis.md
                  SF54 deceleration-history derivation; the LRD comparison object).
    Definition 3: map_correct(q; Ω_BA_fold, a₂-channel) = the frame/normalization correction
                  carrying the bare-frame q into the a_eff(a₂-channel) frame in which SF54 is
                  expressed. Ω_BA_fold = 2.241353 (S97-W1-OMEGA-PROFILE PASS);
                  a₂-channel = the a_2_FW_zeta = 2776.165389 gravitational spectral moment
                  whose Seeley-DeWitt coefficient generates the emergent-FRW a_eff. [a_2^{ζ}]
    Definition 4: band_frac_corrected = (1/N)·Σ_τ 𝟙[ q_corrected(τ) ∈ [−0.97, +0.81] ].

    Substitute (W1-1 ground truth): the cached bare history has q_bare median = −0.866 and
                  band_frac_primary = 0.490; the median is NEGATIVE ⇒ accelerating
                  (ä > 0 ⇒ q = −äa/ȧ² < 0) over the majority of the post-fold window.

    Simplify (direction read-off, step by step):
      Step A: q_corrected(τ) = map_correct(q_bare(τ)) is a smooth monotone reframing
              (a₂-channel normalization is a positive multiplicative + additive shift,
              NOT a sign flip — verified by checking sign(∂q_corrected/∂q_bare) > 0 on the grid).
      Step B: a positive-slope reframe preserves the SIGN of the median: median(q_corrected)
              has the same sign as median(q_bare) = −0.866 < 0  ⇒  median(q_corrected) < 0.
      Step C: a deceleration band [−0.97, +0.81] is centred near q = 0; a distribution whose
              median sits at q < 0 (accelerating) with substantial spread can have
              band_frac < 0.90 WITHOUT the map being ill-defined.

    Canonical form: sign(median q_corrected) = sign(median q_bare) = NEGATIVE (accelerating),
                    AND band_frac_corrected is well-defined (map_correct is a bijection on the grid).

    Direction: median q_corrected < 0 ⇒ substrate is mostly-accelerating post-fold ⇒
               an SF54 band straddling q = 0 is the WRONG band for an accelerating substrate ⇒
               band_frac_corrected < 0.90 is INFORMATIVE (genuine prediction), not a defect.

    Conclusion: PASS (band_frac ≥ 0.90) would mean SF54 IS the right band under the corrected map;
                INFO (band_frac < 0.90 AND map well-defined AND median accelerating) means the
                substrate genuinely predicts a different deceleration history than SF54;
                FAIL means map_correct is ill-defined (non-bijective / sign-ambiguous / NaN on the grid).
                The sign_verdict tests sign(median q_corrected) = sign(median q_bare); the
                magnitude_verdict tests band_frac_corrected vs 0.90.

# (8) input_files
input_files:
  canonical_constants:
    path: "computations/_shared/canonical_constants.py"
    sha256: "<computed-at-runtime>"
  q_nonratio_npz:

  track_B: "0.55 — substrate is structurally mostly-accelerating post-fold and SF54 is the wrong band (INFO: re-scopes the W1-1 miss as a genuine substrate prediction)"
  discriminator: "PASS (band_frac≥0.90) → 0.9 to Track A; INFO (band_frac<0.90, map well-defined, median accelerating) → 0.9 to Track B; FAIL (map ill-defined) → unchanged, routes to mapping-repair CF"

# ---- Output artifacts ----
output_artifacts:

    path: "computations/session-100a/s100a_w1_sf54_mapping.py"
    artifact_kind: "script"

      - "\\*\\*Output Artifacts\\*\\*"

PASS_meaning: "band_frac_corrected ≥ 0.90 — SF54 IS the correct comparison object once the a_eff→SF54 frame correction is applied; the W1-1 band-miss was a frame defect; LRD deceleration concordance reopens; Track A."

substrate_framing: |

  which is generated by the a₂ Seeley-DeWitt coefficient (a_2^{ζ} = 2776.165389) of D_K² — the

Re-integrate the friction ODE q″ + 3Hq′ + k_curv·(q − q_eq(H)) = 0 (k_curv = +3586.5 from s99_w2_relaxation_closure.npz) on arr_H_bare_t (from s99_w1_q_nonratio_observable.npz).   L_max: "N/A — ODE re-integration of cached H(τ) backbone + closed-form q_eq(H); no spectral truncation"
  scan_range: "late-time tail = final 50% of the τ-window (the post-fold relaxation regime where a tracking attractor would manifest); declared explicitly to avoid the W2-1 domain_used_frac=0.41 BREAKDOWN — the regression window is the FULL post-fold tail, not auto-shortened"

  tolerance: "1e-8 (ODE rtol); slope band ±0.05"
  scheme: "FW"
  convention: "SUBSTRATE-NATURAL-BINDING"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "numpy.linalg (cpu-cap-OMP8) — scalar ODE + 1D regression, matrix-free; set OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 before import numpy"
  publication_precision: "4 sig figs (slope; matches the W2-1 slope_bare=3.42 / slope_closure=1.0083 precision)"

# (6) audit_discriminators
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "A substrate-derived q_eq(H) makes the tracking slope d ln q/d ln H = 1 emerge UNFORCED;
             absent such a drive, slope = 1 is recoverable ONLY under the imposed q ∝ H fluid closure."

    Definition 1: friction ODE = q″ + 3Hq′ + V′(q) = 0  (cosmological relaxation of the Volovik
                  vacuum variable q; V(q) = δρ_vac is the GGE/zero-point response of the D_K
                  eigenfrequencies; a₀-channel a_0_FW_zeta = 6440.0). [S99-W2-RELAXATION-CLOSURE]
    Definition 2: V′(q) restoring term = k_curv·(q − q_eq),  k_curv = +3586.5 (convex well at q=0,
                  Routh-Hurwitz attractor sign; from s99_w2_relaxation_closure.npz).
    Definition 3: tracking exponent n in rho_vac ~ H^n satisfies the chain-rule decomposition
                  n = (exponent-on-q) × (d ln q / d ln H)
                  where exponent-on-q = 2 (rho_vac = V(q) ∝ q² near the convex minimum — SUBSTRATE-FORCED
                  by the quadratic V from D_K). [w-1-c10-composite-collapse-adjudication.md]
    Definition 4: q_eq(H) = substrate-derived equilibrium drive. Candidate forms:
                  (i) Volovik Gibbs-Duhem: dP = s·dT + n·dμ; a Hubble-sourced μ(H) shift gives
                      q_eq(H) = (∂q/∂μ)·μ(H), with ρ_vac(eq) = 0 the Gibbs-Duhem constraint (S95);
                  (ii) capstone §6.3 back-reaction closure H² = f(ρ_relic, S_SA) inverted for q_eq(H).
                  NEITHER is the imposed q_eq = c·H simple-fluid closure (the S97 input).

    Substitute (target): for n = 2 (the M_Pl²H² tracking-vacuum law), with exponent-on-q = 2 fixed,
                  2 = 2 × (d ln q / d ln H)  ⇒  d ln q / d ln H = 1.

    Simplify (the test, step by step):
      Step A: substitute q_eq(H) (substrate-derived) into the ODE: q″ + 3Hq′ + k_curv·(q − q_eq(H)) = 0.
      Step B: re-integrate on arr_H_bare_t (the verified non-stationary backbone) WITHOUT imposing

      Step C: regress ln q vs ln H over the post-fold tail ⇒ slope_measured = d ln q / d ln H.
      Step D: compare slope_measured to 1.

    Canonical form: slope_measured = d ln q/d ln H, emergent from the substrate-derived q_eq(H) drive.

    Direction:
      - IF a substrate-derived q_eq(H) exists with NO residual free parameter AND |slope_measured − 1| ≤ 0.05
        ⇒ slope=1 is UNFORCED ⇒ d ln q/d ln H = 1 leg is substrate-forced ⇒ n=2 fully substrate-forced.
      - IF q_eq(H) exists but carries a residual closure parameter that tunes slope toward 1
        ⇒ INFO (slope narrows toward 1 but a closure parameter survives).
      - IF no substrate q_eq(H) drive exists (the only interior equilibrium is q=0, S62 #19, with
        ρ_vac(eq)=0) ⇒ slope=1 remains an imposed-closure artifact ⇒ FAIL (n=2 structurally a
        fluid-closure input; C10 Object-C closes STRUCTURALLY-CONDITIONAL; §8.5 stays OPEN by design).

    Conclusion: PASS ⇒ C10 Object-C → substrate-forced, capstone §8.5 OPEN→CLOSED;
                INFO ⇒ slope narrows with residual closure parameter (track_B confirmed-partial);
                FAIL ⇒ the d ln q/d ln H=1 leg is the imposed closure (the S99 W2-1 reading stands).

# (7) substitution_chain

  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "The NLO slow-variation correction Δn_s^{NLO} is small (|Δn_s^{NLO}| < 0.003), so the
             leading-order tilt n_s = 0.9561 is NLO-precision-stable."

    Definition 1: n_s^{LO} = 1 − 2ε_H = 0.9561  (constant-ε gauge-invariant spectral geometry,
                  S84 T6 / S85 W9-3; n_s_framework canonical, bit-exact Fraction(9561,10000)).
                  ⇒ ε_H = (1 − n_s^{LO})/2 = (1 − 0.9561)/2 = 0.02195. [a_2^{ζ}/a_4^{ζ} moments]
    Definition 2: NLO slow-roll formula (standard single-clock spectral-action form):
                  n_s^{NLO} = 1 − 2ε_H − (2ε_H² + ... ) terms; the NLO correction is
                  Δn_s^{NLO} = n_s^{NLO} − n_s^{LO} = −(C₂·ε_H² + C_η·ε_H·η_H + ...)

                  Δn_s^{NLO} ~ −(C₂·ε_H² + C_η·ε_H·η_H), with C₂, C_η = O(1) and η_H = O(ε_H).
                  ⇒ |Δn_s^{NLO}| ~ O(ε_H²) ~ O(5e-4).

    Simplify (one step per line):
      Step A: |Δn_s^{NLO}| ≈ |C₂|·ε_H² + |C_η|·ε_H·|η_H|.
      Step B: with ε_H = 0.02195, ε_H² = 4.82e-4, and η_H ~ ε_H (single-clock): each term ~ 5e-4.
      Step C: even with C₂, C_η ~ a few, |Δn_s^{NLO}| ~ O(1e-3), comparable to or below 0.003.

               |Δn_s^{NLO}| ≥ 0.009 ⇒ NLO moves the tilt by > 1 Planck-σ ⇒ FAIL (LO anchor
               unstable; the headline n_s is NOT a robust prediction without NLO).

    Claim: "The Leggett-channel DM σ_SI lies BELOW the LZ/XENONnT exclusion at the predicted mass
             M_DM = 11.97·Δ_BCS·M_KK — currently-unexcluded and falsifiable."

PASS_meaning: "σ_SI(M_DM) < σ_excl^{LZ/XENONnT}(M_DM) AND σ_SI ≲ σ_νfog(M_DM) — the Leggett-channel DM cross-section is currently unexcluded and sits at/below the neutrino fog; the DM identity becomes a clean, falsifiable direct-detection target (falsifiable at next-gen below-fog experiments); consistent with the collisionless σ/m = 5.7e-51 cm²/g self-interaction anchor."
FAIL_meaning: "σ_SI(M_DM) > σ_excl^{LZ/XENONnT}(M_DM) — the substrate DM cross-section is already excluded by LZ/XENONnT at the predicted mass; closes the Leggett-channel-as-WIMP-like-direct-detection corridor (informative: the Leggett DM, if real, must couple to nucleons below the substrate's naive estimate, or the rest-energy frame resolution is wrong)."
INFO_meaning: "σ_SI(M_DM) < σ_excl^{LZ/XENONnT}(M_DM) BUT σ_SI > σ_νfog(M_DM) — unexcluded yet above the neutrino fog; a discriminating direct-detection target current/next-gen experiments CAN reach; OR the laboratory-frame rest-energy resolution (substrate M_KK scale vs laboratory rest energy) leaves a residual frame ambiguity that the regime_verdict flags MARGINAL."

## Wave 1 → Wave 2 Decision Point

Wave 1 is structurally independent of Wave 2 (per `session-100a-partition.md`: Wave 1 ⟂ all other waves). No Wave 2 gate consumes a Wave 1 output. The Wave 1 verdicts feed forward into the **session-end register maintenance + capstone-hygiene gate**, NOT into a downstream compute wave:

- **S100a-W1-1-SF54-MAPPING** → if INFO (Track B): capstone §7.1 LRD deceleration-history row re-scoped (substrate mostly-accelerating post-fold; SF54 wrong band) — Q2/Q3 of the capstone-hygiene 5-question gate fire (§7 falsifier-anchor row touched → route to mack-cosmic-bridge). If PASS: LRD concordance reopens. If FAIL: mapping-repair carry-forward to S101.
- **S100a-W1-2-QEQ-DRIVE** → if PASS: capstone §8.5 OPEN→CLOSED + atlas-04 C10 down-conditional (Q1 + Q3 of capstone-hygiene gate fire — a(t)/effective-Friedmann gap status changes). If FAIL/INFO: §8.5 stays OPEN by design; atlas-04 C10 stays ASSUMED-PARTIALLY-PROVEN; the q∝H closure conditionality is pinned (no capstone-status change — corridor-map only).
- **S100a-W1-3-NS-NLO** → if INFO/FAIL: capstone §7 n_s falsifier row gains a precision-stability annotation (Q2 + Q3 fire → mack-cosmic-bridge writes the §7 cell). If PASS: n_s LO anchor confirmed precision-stable (no §7 change).
- **S100a-W1-4-SIGMA-DM-NUCLEON** → on ANY landing: the observational direct-detection row routes to mack-cosmic-bridge (Q2 fires, §7 falsifier surface). The canonical write-order (verdict → canonical_constants → falsifier-master-inventory) is mandatory; `sigma_DM_nucleon_FW` + `M_DM_Leggett_GeV` promote to `canonical_constants.py` via `update_constant` before the inventory row lands.

The capstone-hygiene 5-question gate (`.claude/rules/capstone-hygiene-gate.md`) MUST run at session-close because Wave 1 touches the §7 falsifier surface (W1-1, W1-3, W1-4) and the §8.5/§6.3 a(t)-gap status (W1-2). Routing per the gate: prose down-tags / §7 status-cell updates → housekeeping §A (in-session designated-writer fix); any compute-requiring reconciliation → housekeeping §B with a 4-field spec.
